flavor.description: Equipment: Studded leather armor, arcane focus.

additionalAbilities.name: Pact Magic
additionalAbilities.description: Charisma spellcasting: save DC 18, +10 to hit. Collin has three 5th-level Pact Magic slots, regained after a Short or Long Rest. His selected spells are Guiding Bolt, Cure Wounds, and Counterspell.

additionalAbilities.name: Radiant Soul
additionalAbilities.description: Collin has resistance to radiant damage. Once on each of his turns, when a spell deals fire or radiant damage, he can add +5 to one damage roll against one target.

additionalAbilities.name: Healing Light
additionalAbilities.description:
Bonus Action. Collin heals himself or one creature he can see within 60 ft., spending 1–5 dice from his pool of 16d6. The target regains HP equal to the roll. The pool refills after a Long Rest.
